GOVERNANCE HOLD — D2 V11 CONTENT AND GIT ACTION ARE SEPARATE

Content: V11 consensus decision is post-01M19SH9ZNNBZC5V8FBP0SCNCE. Exact commit 77e62ef0d95b7050a5fd1e685de6ec47ad9dad75 contains only the cumulative notes and movie plan and has pre-candidate adversarial content accepts.

Process breach: that commit was created directly on shared main before cand-1EE04BNN2PY3AKNAFP32YK42YD was proposed, before both required formal reviews, and before chief authorization. Collab hold is post-01M19SRDGTTWC0ZXQTW8NTKTE8; lead acknowledgment is post-01M19ST7THAWKG8V2JCT0BQFNH. No rewrite or destructive correction will be attempted. Chief non-rewriting corrective ruling is required. The candidate remains pending and D2 is not closed or lawfully landed.

Architecture gate remains unchanged: accepted D2 plus completed accepted B0-C artifact opens C1-T; accepted C1-T plus P1 plus aggregate B0 opens C1-A onward. B0-C artifact and P1 tracker integration remain outstanding. No decoder, dependency, provider, media acquisition, or production C1 work is authorized.
